_about: Public-domain Thomas Gunn Selby (1846-1910), Wesleyan Methodist missionary in China and later minister in England, for the Word Hoard: his sermons and lectures: The Imperfect Angel (1892), The Lesson of a Dilemma (1893), The Holy Spirit and Christian Privilege (1894), The Ministry of the Lord Jesus (1896), The Theology of Modern Fiction, the Fernley lecture (1896), The Unheeding God (1899), The God of the Trail (1902), The Alienated Crown (1904), The Strenuous Gospel (1906) and The God-lit City (1911). Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 79 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
